description: Presidential Secretariat - Amend to the Duties and Functions
reasoning: This gazette notification involves both a named individual (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and detailed portfolio responsibilities. It amends previous notifications regarding ministerial portfolios by specifying which departments and entities (e.g., Rakna Arakshana Lanka Ltd., Selendiva Investments Limited, Hotel Developers (Lanka) PLC) fall under specific ministries (Minister of Defence, Minister of Urban Development and Housing, Minister of Investment Promotion). This constitutes both "who" (the President making the changes) and "what" (detailed portfolio assignments), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
